summary: Western Midstream Operating, LP filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a public offering of $700 million in 5.700% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes are senior unsecured obligations governed by an indenture, with interest payable semi-annually and maturity on July 1, 2036. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No special-situations category applies.
